thesis: Physical dependence does not entail explanatory replacement or computational accessibility at the lowest level.

ideas.statement: Ontological, methodological and explanatory reduction differ; organization and intervention can demand higher-level descriptions.
Known microscopic rules need not provide algorithms for all macro-properties, while pluralism still requires compatible constraints and testable relations.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Infinite-system undecidability does not automatically transfer to every finite material.
